body:
## What's Changed
* Migrated to custom main thread queue @StarkMP 
* Moved control toggles to ui thread @wessleym 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/compare/1.5.0...1.5.1

## What's Changed
* fix: iframe text input (IME) by @Dekana in https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/pull/28
* feat: VR integration layer (PrismaVR) by @Wondernuttz in https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/pull/22
* feat: add gamepad support by @wessleym in https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/pull/33
* Added a JavaScript API, TypeScript type definition, and revised events by @wessleym in https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/pull/36
* Support for Skyrim 1.7 by @StarkMP in https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/pull/39

## New Contributors
* @Wondernuttz made their first contribution in https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/pull/22
* @wessleym made their first contribution in https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/pull/33

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/compare/1.4.1...1.5.0

name: 1.5.0-vr
body:
### VR Support Alpha Test

This is a test release featuring VR support, based on [PR #22](https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/pull/22).
Please share your feedback in the **#news** channel on our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/QYztzZY8RG).

Thanks [@Wondernutzz](https://github.com/Wondernuttz)

- [Documentation](https://www.prismaui.dev/getting-started/introduction/)
- [Open an issue](https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/issues)

### Demo
https://youtu.be/5yuIWa3MOtw

### Website
https://www.prismaui.dev

### Changes
- Added new `RegisterConsoleCallback` API method to `IVPrismaUI2` interface
- Added IME partial support
- Fixed WndProc hook installation issue
- Updated CommonLib-NG version to `4.2.0` version

### Credits
@StarkMP @langfod @Dekana @tetherball88

### Credits
@StarkMP

- [Documentation](https://www.prismaui.dev/getting-started/introduction/)
- [Open an issue](https://github.com/PrismaUI-SKSE/framework/issues)

### Demo
https://youtu.be/5yuIWa3MOtw

### Website
https://www.prismaui.dev

### Changes
- Added Ultralight Inspector (Beta) with new API methods
- Added dynamic DLL loading (now you shouldn't put files in skyrim root directory)
- Migrated to CMake project configuration (xmake is removed)
- Reworked project building flow
- Minor code improvements
- Added new argument `disableFocusMenu` to `Focus` method to disable FocusMenu when focusing
- Added new API method `HasAnyActiveFocus` to check if any focus is active

### Credits
Huge thanks to @langfod for helping!
@StarkMP 

> **IMPORTANT:** Requires **full framework reinstall** with new installation method.
